content: Diya Menon reached out to insurance agent Ravi Menon to understand the difference between reinstating her lapsed insurance policy and buying a new one. Ravi explained that reinstatement reactivates the old policy with the same terms upon payment of lapsed premiums and a fee, while a new policy offers updated terms and potential better coverage but requires going through underwriting and may exclude pre-existing conditions. Ravi offered to provide quotes for both options.

action_items: Provide quotes for policy reinstatement and buying a new policy
